llm_planner_unreferenced.note: 12 runs launched by the LLM planner are named by no stored result and have no live owner process. 12 of them were created before at least one event that restarts LLM loops (a commit to fingerprinted decision code: benchmark results stamped with an older fingerprint are recomputed when the benchmark script next runs; or a container restart, after which the benchmark and attack scripts were relaunched); for 12 of them, an LLM result for the same case in results/logs was written by a process launched after the run was created. They come from LLM loops that were aborted and restarted from the root; the restarted loop rewrote the case's partial and final result, which do not name these runs. The planner calls that proposed them, and their LLM cost (`cost_usd` in a loop's history), are not recorded in any stored result. Their simulation cost recorded in evidence.json is 3.85e+09 cell-steps; 'running' records among them have no evidence file, so the compute they used before their owner died is not recorded either. 7 further unnamed LLM-planner runs have a live owner: their loops are still running, and a loop names a run in its partial file once the run finishes.
